GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2019-10-22T08:19:00Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: I wonder how storage policy do on disk failure.
Description: My ClickHouse configurations are like below.

* Node1
  - two disks 
    * /data1
    * /data2

* Node2
  - two disks
    * /data1
    * /data2

Data is replicated between Node1 and Node2 by ReplicatedMergeTree. 
And each ReplicatedMergeTree uses the below storage_policy.
So ReplicatedMergeTree splits data into two disks; /data1 and /data2.

**Settings**
```XML
<storage_configuration>                                                          
    <disks>                                                                      
        <jbod1>                                                                  
            <path>./jbod1/</path>                                                
            <keep_free_space_bytes>1024</keep_free_space_bytes>                  
        </jbod1>                                                                 
        <jbod2>                                                                  
            <path>./jbod2/</path>                                                
            <keep_free_space_bytes>1024</keep_free_space_bytes>                  
        </jbod2>                                                                 
    </disks>                                                                     
                                                                                 
    <policies>                                                                   
        <jbods>                                                                  
            <volumes>                                                            
                <main>                                                           
                    <disk>jbod1</disk>                                           
                    <disk>jbod2</disk>                                           
                </main>                                                          
            </volumes>                                                           
        </jbods>                                                                 
    </policies>                                                                  
</storage_configuration>                                                         
```

What happen If `/data1` on Node1 is broken?
Does Node1 lose the data on `/data1`?
Or Does Node1 copy data from Node2?

Thank you in advance.
